description: This file defines the GraphingCalculatorViewModel class, which is a ViewModel component for a graphing calculator application. It includes properties for equations, variables, and UI state, as well as methods for updating variables and handling button presses.

classes.name: GraphingCalculatorViewModel
classes.description: A sealed class implementing INotifyPropertyChanged, serving as the ViewModel for the graphing calculator UI, with observable properties for equations, variables, and UI state, and methods for handling user interactions.

methods.name: UpdateVariables
methods.description: Updates the ViewModel's variables based on a provided map of variable names to Variable objects.

methods.name: SetSelectedEquation
methods.description: Sets the currently selected equation in the ViewModel.

methods.name: OnButtonPressed
methods.description: Handles button press events triggered from the UI.
